editorial:
Jail Bait is Ed Wood's 1954 crime film, released May 12, 1954 by Howco Productions. It runs 71 minutes. Its working title was The Hidden Face. In the story, Vic Brady, a gangster, and the plastic surgeon's son, Don Gregor, break into a theater, and the night watchman is killed. Lyle Talbot, Clancy Malone, Timothy Farrell and Dolores Fuller appear. Steve Reeves has a small early role as a police lieutenant. It was Herbert Rawlinson's last film.

The trap is that the print's status is unconfirmed. The renewal window for a 1954 work is the 1981-1982 window.
